mapper.insert: insert into integration_schema.sync_alert(job_code,run_id,category,severity,dedup_key,summary) values (#{jobCode},#{runId},#{category},'ERROR',#{dedupKey},#{summary}) on conflict(dedup_key) do update set run_id=excluded.run_id,summary=excluded.summary,last_seen_at=clock_timestamp(), first_seen_at=case when integration_schema.sync_alert.status='RESOLVED' then clock_timestamp() else integration_schema.sync_alert.first_seen_at end, occurrence_count=case when integration_schema.sync_alert.status='RESOLVED' then 1 else integration_schema.sync_alert.occurrence_count+1 end, status=case when integration_schema.sync_alert.status='RESOLVED' then 'OPEN' else integration_schema.sync_alert.status end
mapper.update: update integration_schema.sync_alert set status='RESOLVED' where job_code=#{jobCode} and category='RECONCILIATION'
mapper.select: select count(*) from integration_schema.sync_alert where job_code=#{jobCode} and status<>'RESOLVED'
select count(*) from integration_schema.sync_alert where job_code=#{jobCode}
select * from integration_schema.sync_alert where job_code=#{jobCode} order by (status='RESOLVED'),last_seen_at desc,id desc limit #{size} offset #{offset}
mapper.update: update integration_schema.sync_alert set status='ACKNOWLEDGED' where id=#{id} and status='OPEN'
